svg.title: Freight operations assistant: proposed C4 Container diagram for 50 customers
svg.desc: Proposed design. Operator to Web Client to API Gateway to an Operations Assistant API. The API returns a cached answer or a durable job ID. SQS sends jobs to Lambda workers. Workers use SQL, model calls and limited carrier calls. Postgres has tenant access rules, jobs, caches and rate counters, with a standby in another zone. S3 and the vector database have tenant access controls. Background jobs update shipment data and the document index. CloudWatch holds logs and alarms.
svg.text: C4 Container diagram / Proposed design for 50 customers
Checks tenant access and job limits
Returns a cached answer or job ID
Limits for jobs and carrier calls
Tenant rules, jobs, caches and quotas
Primary and standby in two zones
Read cache / save job / read result
SQL reports / save results / share recent status
The API does not wait for long work.
The client reads results by job ID.
